oracle: the closed-form Gaussian-mixture CPHD update (Vo, Vo and Cantoni 2007), re-derived from the basic multi-object likelihood and checked against brute-force association enumeration -- see the module docstring
stonesoup_status: no CPHD updater exists in this version -- stonesoup.updater.pointprocess exports only PHDUpdater, confirmed by import rather than assumed
method_note: The intensity is compared as a FUNCTION -- its integral, and its value at fixed probe points -- not as a component list, for the same reason as the PHD row: two correct filters that prune and merge in a different order carry the same intensity in a different number of components.
